typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DBPassword as string (),
	DBServerName as string (),
	EmailRecipients as string (),
	ErrorEmailRecipients as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	File_Exists_Fl as string (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	InitialCatalog as string (),
	NoFileEmailRecipients as string (),
	RecordsCCIDLessThan10Chars as integer (),
	RecordsImported as integer (),
	RecordsInSrcFile as integer (),
	RecordsMissingCCID as integer (),
	RecordsMissingDomainID as integer (),
	UserName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Domain as string,
		Care_Coord_Primary_Key as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Create_Date = currentTimestamp(),
		Care_Coordinator_ID = left(replace(replace(Care_Coord_Primary_Key, toString('\"'), toString('')), toString(' '), toString('')), 10),
		Domain_ID = replace(replace(Domain, toString('\"'), toString('')), toString(' '), toString('')),
		FileName = right($ImportFile, locate('\\', reverse($ImportFile), 1) - 1)) ~> DeriveFields
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCountAGGREGATE
DeriveFields split(length(Care_Coordinator_ID) < 10,iifNull(Domain_ID,'') == '',iifNull(Care_Coordinator_ID,'') == '', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(CCIDislessthan10chars,DomainIDisNULL,CCIDisnull,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
RowCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput sink(input(
		Care_Coordinator_ID as string,
		CREATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FileName as string,
		Domain_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Care_Coordinator_ID,
		CREATE_DATE = Create_Date,
		FileName,
		Domain_ID)) ~> KanCareCCIDLookuptable
